title: Astrid and the Colony
author: Wren Whitlock
blurb: Hazel Ravensworth, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
